newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Axiom Properties to bid for R&I.
newsitem.headline: Axiom Properties to bid for R&I.

text.p: Axiom Properties Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to make a takeover bid for Perth-based investment group Resource and Industry Ltd on the basis of two fully paid shares in Axiom for every three R&I shares.
R&I shares last traded at 40 cents on Tuesday, valuing the company at A$15.96 million. Axiom shares last traded at 46 cents on Tuesday, valuing the property developer at A$45.3 million.

Axiom said it was a term of the offer that, prior to the closing date of the offer, R&I received all regulatory and court approvals to allow distributions totalling 17 cents per share, comprising the eight cent per share return of capital approved by shareholders on April 30 and further distributions totalling nine cents per share.
R&I shareholders who accept the Axiom offer will retain their entitlement to receive the distributions, Axiom said.
"Based on Axiom's recent share price of 45 cents per share, the offer values RAI shares at 30 cents plus 17 cents proposed return of capital," Axiom said.
R&I optionholders also will be offered an option to subscribe for one unissued Axiom share for each R&I option.
Both series of options are exercisable at $1.00 with a maturity date of June 30, 1999.

R&I recently accepted a placement of 8.5 Axiom shares issued at 41 cents per share, representing about 8.6 percent of Axiom's expanded share capital prior to any shares being issued pursuant to the takeover offer.
If all R&I shareholders accept the Axiom offers, Axiom will issue about 26.6 million new Axiom shares, which would represent about 21.3 percent of Axiom's expanded capital.
R&I shareholders who accept the Axiom offer will participate in the dividend for the year ended June 30, currently forecast to be 3.9 cents per Axiom share.
Axiom was listed on the Australian Stock Exchange in January after raising A$8 million through an issue of 20 million shares at an issue price of 40 cents per share.
